description: A mixer of up to eight inputs whose channel levels are drawn from simplex noise, so the blend drifts or jumps at random instead of being set by hand.

params.text: Sets how fast the noise driving the levels moves, 0.005 at the left to 1 at the right.
Sets how many octaves of noise are summed into the level movement, 1 for smooth movement through to 8 for movement full of small bumps.
At ON TRIG the levels only change when a trigger arrives; at FREE they change continuously.
Multiplies the noise before it is clipped, 1 at the left to 10 at the right, so higher settings hold a channel fully open or fully shut for longer and cross between them faster.

inputs.text: One of the signals to be mixed; a channel is only given a level, and only reaches the mix, while its jack is patched.
A rising edge picks a new set of channel levels while the switch is at ON TRIG.
Adds a tenth of its voltage to SPEED, and the total is held inside the knob's own range.
Adds to JITTER, -5V adding nothing and +5V adding five; the total is held inside the knob's own range.

outputs.text: The patched inputs added together at their current levels and divided by the sum of those levels, so the overall loudness stays near steady as the blend changes.

notes: The switch comes up at ON TRIG and every channel level starts at 0, so a newly placed module is silent until a trigger reaches TRIG or the switch is moved to FREE.
A channel level runs from fully shut to fully open and never inverts the signal.
The green lamp beside a channel shows that channel's present level.
Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is mixed.

inputs.16: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
